connector.name: ESG MCP Servers
connector.registryDescription: 31 MCP tools for ESG data extraction, PDF processing, vector search, and EU regulation analysis.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package esg-mcp-servers. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the freminder account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key — required for RAG queries and LLM-based metric extraction

env.name: POSTGRES_DSN
env.description: PostgreSQL connection string with pgvector extension (e.g. postgresql://esg:esg@localhost/esg_platform)

env.name: MONGODB_URI
env.description: MongoDB connection string for PDF binary storage via GridFS (e.g. mongodb://localhost:27017)

env.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Sentence-transformer model name for embedding generation (default: Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-l-v2.0)
